name: zclass_world_add_child_at_grid
description: zClass_World::AddChildAtGrid attaches whole-world or out-of-bounds children generically and inserts bounded children into the area grid.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/grid source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4510e0 validates the whole-world fast path, out-of-grid generic fallback, cached-bound extraction, grid-index conversion, and grid-cell insertion.
The native smoke verifies generic insertion for whole-world and out-of-bounds children plus grid-cell insertion for a bounded child.
